items.question: Which entity is to be worshipped in the mandala after the radiant powers?
premises: purusha and sun are accusative objects
items.inference: the sun-purusha is worshipped in the mandala after the radiant powers
uncertainties: exact ritual sequence beyond the supplied context
items.plain_english: After worshipping the radiant and other powers, one worships the sun-purusha in the mandala.
